mapper.sql: rr.id, rr.user_id, rr.workation_id, rr.recommendation_type, rr.meal_type, rr.reference_type, rr.reference_merchant_id, rr.secondary_reference_merchant_id, rr.reference_latitude, rr.reference_longitude, rr.created_at, m.name AS reference_merchant_name, sm.name AS secondary_reference_merchant_name
mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS workation_id, w.region_id, w.start_date, w.end_date, (SELECT SUM(b.target_amount) FROM budgets b JOIN expense_categories ec ON ec.id = b.expense_category_id WHERE b.workation_id = w.id AND b.budget_type = 'PERSONAL' AND ec.code = 'LEISURE') AS leisure_budget, (SELECT so.option_code FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.user_id = w.user_id AND us.workation_id = w.id AND sq.question_code = 'Q1' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS priority_option_code, (SELECT so.option_name FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.user_id = w.user_id AND us.workation_id = w.id AND sq.question_code = 'Q1' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS priority_option_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(so.option_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.user_id = w.user_id AND us.workation_id = w.id AND sq.question_code = 'Q3' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 3) AS selected_activity_codes, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(so.option_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM user_surveys us JOIN user_survey_answers usa ON usa.survey_id = us.id JOIN survey_options so ON so.id = usa.option_id JOIN survey_questions sq ON sq.id = so.question_id WHERE us.user_id = w.user_id AND us.workation_id = w.id AND sq.question_code = 'Q3' ORDER BY usa.id DESC LIMIT 3) AS selected_activity_names FROM workations w WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.id = #{workationId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, m.latitude, m.longitude, a.activity_type, CAST(COUNT(r.review_id) AS UNSIGNED) AS review_count, NULL AS difficulty FROM merchants m JOIN activities a ON a.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.merchant_id = m.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.region_id = #{regionId} AND m.category = 'ACTIVITY' GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, m.latitude, m.longitude, a.activity_type ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, m.name AS merchant_name, m.category, m.address, m.thumbnail_url, m.price, m.rating, m.latitude, m.longitude, 1 AS reserved FROM reservations r JOIN reservation_products rp ON rp.id = r.product_id JOIN merchants m ON m.id = rp.merchant_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.workation_id = #{workationId} AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND m.category = 'ACCOMMODATION' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1
